 What our Post expert thinks about Jazz vs. Lakers
 Luka Doncic is having an absolute monster season for the Lakers in his first season as the guy. Not only is Doncic leading the NBA in scoring by a wide margin, he and Austin Reaves are combining for more than 60 points per game this season. Doncic already scored 52 points against the Jazz this season and could be in line for another huge game Wednesday.
